title: A2A Extensions and Utilities
summary: This module provides extensions and utilities for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including A2UI (Agent-to-Agent User Interface) support, agent card management, gRPC authentication, and task execution helpers.

nodes.label: A2UI Client Extension
nodes.title: A2UIClientExtension
nodes.description: Injects A2UI prompt instructions, tracks UI state, and validates A2UI messages in agent responses for client-side A2UI integration.

nodes.label: A2UI Server Extension
nodes.title: A2UIServerExtension
nodes.description: Negotiates A2UI catalog preferences and wraps A2UI messages from agent responses into A2A DataParts for server-side A2UI integration.

nodes.label: Validate A2UI v0.8 Message
nodes.title: validate_a2ui_event, _build_data_part
nodes.description: Parses and validates A2UI v0.8 client-to-server events and messages, ensuring they conform to the schema before processing.

nodes.label: Validate A2UI v0.9 Message
nodes.title: validate_a2ui_event_v09, _build_data_part_v09, validate_catalog_components_v09
nodes.description: Parses and validates A2UI v0.9 client-to-server events and messages, including catalog component validation for schema compliance.

nodes.label: Extract Extension URIs
nodes.title: get_extensions_from_config
nodes.description: Extracts and deduplicates extension URIs from A2A configuration objects, providing a list of active extensions.

nodes.label: Generate Agent Card
nodes.title: _to_agent_card, _crew_to_agent_card
nodes.description: Creates an A2A AgentCard from an Agent or Crew instance, describing its capabilities, endpoints, and available skills.

nodes.label: Verify Agent Card Signature
nodes.title: verify_agent_card_signature
nodes.description: Validates the JWS signature of an AgentCard using a public key to ensure its authenticity and integrity, preventing tampering.

nodes.label: gRPC Auth Interceptors
nodes.title: AuthMetadataPlugin, MetadataUnaryUnary, MetadataUnaryStream, MetadataStreamUnary, MetadataStreamStream
nodes.description: Provides gRPC client interceptors to inject authentication metadata into unary and stream calls for secure A2A communication.

nodes.label: Configure JSON Logging
nodes.title: configure_json_logging
nodes.description: Sets up structured JSON logging for the A2A module, replacing default handlers with a JSON formatter for better log analysis.

nodes.label: Execute A2A Task with Extensions
nodes.title: execute_with_extensions
nodes.description: Orchestrates the execution of an A2A task, applying server extension hooks before and after agent processing for custom logic.

nodes.label: Monitor Task Cancellation
nodes.title: watch_for_cancel
nodes.description: Monitors for task cancellation events using a pub/sub mechanism or polling, allowing long-running tasks to be gracefully terminated.

nodes.label: Agent Module
nodes.title: Agent & Crew Orchestration
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle and execution of AI agents and crews, including their interactions and tool usage.

nodes.label: A2A Configuration
nodes.title: A2A Communication Core
nodes.description: Defines core configurations and mechanisms for Agent-to-Agent communication, including update handlers.

nodes.label: Event & State Management
nodes.title: Event & State Management
nodes.description: Handles event bus, state checkpoints, and various event types within the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: gRPC Framework
nodes.title: gRPC Framework
nodes.description: The underlying gRPC framework used for inter-service communication.

nodes.label: JWS Library
nodes.title: JSON Web Signature Library
nodes.description: A library for creating and verifying JSON Web Signatures (JWS).

nodes.label: Cache/PubSub System
nodes.title: Cache/PubSub System
nodes.description: A caching or publish-subscribe system (e.g., Redis) used for inter-process communication.

groups.label: A2UI Interaction
groups.title: Agent-to-Agent User Interface (A2UI)
groups.description: Components facilitating declarative UI generation and interaction between agents and clients using the A2UI protocol.

groups.label: Agent Card Management
groups.title: Agent Card Generation and Verification
groups.description: Utilities for creating and securely verifying AgentCards, which describe an agent's capabilities for A2A discovery.

groups.label: A2A Infrastructure
groups.title: Core A2A Communication Infrastructure
groups.description: Foundational components for secure and observable A2A communication, including gRPC interception and logging.

groups.label: Task Orchestration
groups.title: A2A Task Execution and Control
groups.description: Components for executing A2A tasks with extension hooks and monitoring for cancellation to ensure robust operation.

groups.label: Extension Configuration
groups.title: A2A Extension Configuration Handling
groups.description: Utility for extracting and managing extension URIs from A2A configurations.
